description: This file contains a script for upgrading firmware on MMC devices, specifically handling kernel and root filesystem flashing, loop device setup, and post-flash cleanup procedures used within the OpenWRT build environment.

methods.name: mmc_do_upgrade
methods.description: Main function to coordinate the MMC upgrade process, finding relevant kernel and rootfs partitions and invoking the flash procedure.

methods.name: mmc_do_flash
methods.description: Performs the actual flashing of kernel and rootfs images onto the device, including setting up loop devices and formatting the rootfs data partition.
